calls.cypher: CALL algo.MSpaths({sourceLabel: 'Type', sourceProperty: 'name', sourceValues: ['session', 'text.query'], targetLabel: 'Type', targetProperty: 'name', targetValues: ['gitlab.project', 'github.repo', 'linear.team_id', 'jira.issue_type', 'jira.project_key'], pairwise: false, relTypes: ['FEEDS', 'YIELDS'], relDirection: 'outgoing', maxLen: 8, pathCount: 3, resultLimit: 1000}) YIELD path, pathWeight RETURN path, pathWeight

calls.label: rank.next
calls.cypher: MATCH (a:Tool)-[n:NEXT]->(b:Tool) RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b, n.count AS count, n.success AS success

calls.label: tool_meta
calls.cypher: MATCH (t:Tool) WHERE t.name IN $names RETURN t.name AS name, t.server AS server, t.tool AS tool, t.description AS description, t.input_schema AS input_schema, t.schema_tokens AS schema_tokens, t.reads_private AS reads_private, t.ingests_untrusted AS ingests_untrusted, t.exfil_sink AS exfil_sink, t.destructive AS destructive, t.read_only AS read_only, t.synthetic AS synthetic, t.caps AS caps, t.io AS io

calls.label: feeds
calls.cypher: MATCH (ty:Type)-[f:FEEDS]->(t:Tool) WHERE t.name IN $tools RETURN t.name AS tool, ty.name AS type, f.param AS param, f.required AS required

calls.label: emit.preload_tokens
calls.cypher: MATCH (t:Tool) RETURN sum(t.schema_tokens) AS n
